record.original_question: Let Omega in C^n be a bounded biholomorphic image of the unit ball in C^n . Does the d-bar satisfy uniform estimates on Omega? The problem is of interest mainly when Omega has very rough boundary.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ be a bounded domain that is biholomorphic to the open unit ball $\mathbb{B}^n = \{z \in \mathbb{C}^n : |z| < 1\}$ (so there exists a biholomorphism $\Phi : \mathbb{B}^n \to \Omega$; no regularity of $\partial\Omega$ is assumed, and $\partial\Omega$ may be very rough). For a $\bar\partial$-closed $(0,1)$-form $f$ on $\Omega$ with bounded coefficients, consider the inhomogeneous Cauchy–Riemann equation $\bar\partial u = f$ on $\Omega$.

Question: Does $\bar\partial$ satisfy uniform estimates on $\Omega$? That is, does there exist a constant $C = C(\Omega) > 0$ such that, for every bounded $\bar\partial$-closed $(0,1)$-form $f$ on $\Omega$, one can find a solution $u \in L^\infty(\Omega)$ of $\bar\partial u = f$ with
$$\|u\|_{L^\infty(\Omega)} \le C\, \|f\|_{L^\infty(\Omega)} ?$$
artifact.status_search_result: Berndtsson and collaborators have obtained uniform (sup-norm) $\bar\partial$ estimates with weights on the unit ball and various pseudoconvex/convex finite-type domains, but no search result confirms that the question for arbitrary bounded biholomorphic images of the ball with rough boundary has been resolved. The status appears unknown/open based on available sources.

status_evidence.title: Uniform estimates with weights for the d-bar equation
status_evidence.snippet: Berndtsson develops uniform L-infinity estimates with weights for solutions of the d-bar equation, primarily on the unit ball and similar model domains.
status_evidence.claim: Uniform d-bar estimates are established on the ball with weights, not for general biholomorphic images with rough boundary.

status_evidence.title: Some Remarks on Berndtsson's Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work studies Berndtsson's conjecture on sup-norm estimates for solutions of the d-bar equation in the unit ball with bounded rotation-symmetric weights.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent research on related Berndtsson conjectures suggests the rough-boundary biholomorphic-image question is not known to be settled.

status_evidence.title: Sharp pointwise and uniform estimates for d-bar
status_evidence.snippet: Sharp pointwise and uniform estimates for the d-bar equation on smoothly bounded model domains.
status_evidence.claim: Results are obtained for smooth/finite-type domains; rough-boundary biholomorphic images of the ball are not covered.
